diagnosis: The Fastify plugin architecture uses fastify-plugin to expose a global resolveVaultFile decorator that queries files strictly by fileId. The nested route handler /api/v1/vaults/:vaultId/files/:fileId/content accepts both vaultId and fileId, but queries solely via the global helper without verifying that the file belongs to vaultId or that the user has read permissions on that vault. An attacker can access confidential files in other vaults by guessing or enumerating fileId.
